# mondoo_integration_aws_serverless (Resource)

Continuously scan AWS organizations and accounts for misconfigurations and vulnerabilities.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "aws_region" {
  description = "AWS Region"
  type        = string
  default     = "us-east-1"
}

variable "aws_account_id" {
  description = "The AWS account ID"
  type        = string
}

provider "mondoo" {
  space = "hungry-poet-123456"
}

provider "aws" {
  region = var.aws_region
}

data "aws_region" "current" {}

# Set up the AWS integration
resource "mondoo_integration_aws_serverless" "aws_serverless" {
  name                          = "AWS Integration"
  region                        = data.aws_region.current.region
  is_organization               = false
  console_sign_in_trigger       = true
  instance_state_change_trigger = true
  account_ids                   = [var.aws_account_id]
  scan_configuration = {
    ec2_scan           = true
    ecr_scan           = false
    ecs_scan           = false
    cron_scan_in_hours = 24
    ec2_scan_options = {
      ssm              = true
      ebs_volume_scan  = true
      instance_connect = false
      exclude_tags_filter = {
        "Created By" = "Mondoo"
        "Env"        = "dev"
      }
    }
  }
}

# for single account deploys
resource "aws_cloudformation_stack" "mondoo_stack" {
  name         = "mondoo-stack"
  template_url = mondoo_integration_aws_serverless.aws_serverless.cloud_formation_template_url
  capabilities = ["CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM"]
  parameters = {
    MondooIntegrationMrn = mondoo_integration_aws_serverless.aws_serverless.mrn
    MondooToken          = mondoo_integration_aws_serverless.aws_serverless.token
    MondooSourceBucket   = mondoo_integration_aws_serverless.aws_serverless.source_bucket
  }
}

# for organization-wide deployments use aws_cloudformation_stack_set and aws_cloudformation_stack_set_instance instead of aws_cloudformation_stack
# set is_organization = true (and leave account_ids unset) so the token does not expire; with false it expires after 30 minutes,
# and accounts that join a targeted OU later fail to register
# https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs/resources/cloudformation_stack_set
# https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs/resources/cloudformation_stack_set_instance

# With Workload Identity Federation the Lambda authenticates to Mondoo without a
# token: Mondoo creates the WIF binding for the integration, and the stack takes
# the MondooWifConfig parameter in place of MondooToken.
resource "mondoo_integration_aws_serverless" "aws_serverless_wif" {
  name           = "AWS Integration (WIF)"
  region         = data.aws_region.current.region
  use_wif        = true
  aws_account_id = var.aws_account_id
  scan_configuration = {
    ec2_scan = true
    ec2_scan_options = {
      ssm = true
    }
  }
}

resource "aws_cloudformation_stack" "mondoo_wif_stack" {
  name         = "mondoo-wif-stack"
  template_url = mondoo_integration_aws_serverless.aws_serverless_wif.cloud_formation_template_url
  capabilities = ["CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM"]
  parameters = {
    MondooIntegrationMrn = mondoo_integration_aws_serverless.aws_serverless_wif.mrn
    MondooWifConfig      = mondoo_integration_aws_serverless.aws_serverless_wif.wif_config
    MondooSourceBucket   = mondoo_integration_aws_serverless.aws_serverless_wif.source_bucket
  }
}

variable "mondoo_organization_mrn" {
  description = "The Mondoo organization MRN to create the cross-account integration in."
  type        = string
  default     = ""
}

# In a Mondoo organization: the organization's asset routing rules place each
# scanned account's assets into spaces. An integration in an organization
# authenticates with WIF. Cross-account scanning assumes the named role in every
# account whose tags match; deploy that role into the accounts with a StackSet.
# The hub stack is deployed as for aws_serverless_wif above, with this
# integration's mrn, wif_config and source_bucket.
resource "mondoo_integration_aws_serverless" "aws_serverless_org" {
  scope_mrn      = var.mondoo_organization_mrn
  name           = "AWS Organization"
  region         = data.aws_region.current.region
  use_wif        = true
  aws_account_id = var.aws_account_id
  scan_configuration = {
    account_scan       = true
    cross_account_scan = true
    cross_account_scan_options = {
      role_name    = "MondooCrossAccountScan"
      account_tags = { "mondoo" = "scan" }
    }
    ec2_scan_options = {
      ebs_volume_scan = true
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the integration.
- `region` (String) AWS region.
- `scan_configuration` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scan_configuration))

### Optional

- `account_ids` (List of String) List of AWS account IDs.
- `aws_account_id` (String) The AWS account the Lambda is deployed in. Required when `use_wif` is true, and only valid then. Immutable: changing it forces a new integration.
- `console_sign_in_trigger` (Boolean) Enable console sign-in trigger.
- `instance_state_change_trigger` (Boolean) Enable instance state change trigger.
- `is_organization` (Boolean) Set to `true` when you deploy the CloudFormation template with a StackSet, whether it targets the whole AWS organization or only some organizational units (OUs). Mondoo then issues a `token` that never expires, so accounts that join a targeted OU later can still register. When unset or `false`, the `token` expires 30 minutes after the integration is created. Set this when you create the integration: changing it later does not replace the `token` already in the Terraform state, so recreate the integration to get a token that does not expire. Cannot be combined with `account_ids`.
- `scope_mrn` (String) The MRN of the scope the integration is created in: a space (`//captain.api.mondoo.app/spaces/<space-id>`), or an organization (`//captain.api.mondoo.app/organizations/<org-id>`), whose asset routing rules place the assets of every scanned account into spaces. When omitted, the integration is created in `space_id`, else in the provider's space. Immutable: changing it forces a new integration.
- `space_id` (String, Deprecated) Mondoo space identifier. Deprecated: set `scope_mrn` instead. If neither is set, the provider space is used.
- `use_wif` (Boolean) Authenticate the Lambda to Mondoo with Workload Identity Federation instead of the `token`: Mondoo creates the WIF binding for the integration, and `wif_config` carries the stack's `MondooWifConfig` parameter. Requires `aws_account_id`. Immutable: changing it forces a new integration.

### Read-Only

- `cloud_formation_template_url` (String) The CloudFormation template URL for the integration's region (populated by Mondoo after creation). Use it as the `template_url` of the `aws_cloudformation_stack` resource.
- `mrn` (String) Integration identifier.
- `source_bucket` (String) The S3 bucket the Lambda code is published to for the integration's region (populated by Mondoo after creation). Pass it as the `MondooSourceBucket` parameter of the `aws_cloudformation_stack` resource.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Registration token for the integration. Pass it as the `MondooToken` parameter of the CloudFormation stack or StackSet; a separate `mondoo_registration_token` is not needed. With `use_wif`, pass `wif_config` as `MondooWifConfig` instead and leave `MondooToken` unset. The Mondoo Lambda exchanges it once per account, when the stack is created, for service account credentials that do not expire. The token expires 30 minutes after the integration is created, unless `is_organization` is `true`, in which case it never expires.
- `wif_config` (String, Sensitive) For an integration with `use_wif`, how its Lambda authenticates to Mondoo (populated by Mondoo after creation). Pass it as the `MondooWifConfig` parameter of the `aws_cloudformation_stack` resource, in place of `MondooToken`. Unset for an integration without WIF.

<a id="nestedatt--scan_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scan_configuration`

Required:

- `ec2_scan_options` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scan_configuration--ec2_scan_options))

Optional:

- `account_scan` (Boolean) Enable AWS account scan. Defaults to true when not set.
- `cron_scan_expression` (String) Scan schedule as a standard 5-field cron expression in UTC, e.g. `0 3 * * MON-FRI` for 03:00 on weekdays. Takes precedence over `cron_scan_in_hours`. Mondoo rejects an expression that restricts both day-of-month and day-of-week, or that scans more often than once an hour.
- `cron_scan_in_hours` (Number) Cron scan in hours.
- `cross_account_scan` (Boolean) Enable cross-account scanning: the Lambda assumes `cross_account_scan_options.role_name` in each target account and scans it from the account it is deployed in.
- `cross_account_scan_options` (Attributes) Which accounts cross-account scanning targets, and the IAM role it assumes in each. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scan_configuration--cross_account_scan_options))
- `discovery_targets` (List of String) The AWS discovery targets the account scan runs, e.g. `["auto"]` or `["accounts", "s3-buckets"]`. When unset, the Lambda uses its built-in targets. Targets that scan workloads directly, such as `instances` or `ecr`, are rejected: `ec2_scan` and `ecr_scan` cover those.
- `ec2_scan` (Boolean) Enable EC2 scan.
- `ecr_scan` (Boolean) Enable ECR scan.
- `ecs_scan` (Boolean) Enable ECS scan.
- `event_scan_triggers` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scan_configuration--event_scan_triggers))
- `propagate_account_tags` (Boolean) Propagate the AWS account tags to every asset discovered in the account.
- `scheduling` (String) **Experimental:** this attribute may change or be removed in a future release. Who drives the scan cycle, one of: `LAMBDA` (the deployed Lambda keeps its own scan queue, the default) or `SERVER` (Mondoo keeps the queue, and the Lambda reports what it discovers and pulls its work). When unset, the integration keeps its current setting.
- `vpc_configuration` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scan_configuration--vpc_configuration))

<a id="nestedatt--scan_configuration--ec2_scan_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scan_configuration.ec2_scan_options`

Optional:

- `ebs_scan_options` (Attributes, Deprecated) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scan_configuration--ec2_scan_options--ebs_scan_options))
- `ebs_volume_scan` (Boolean) Enable EBS volume scan.
- `exclude_instance_ids_filter` (List of String) List of instance IDs to exclude.
- `exclude_regions_filter` (List of String) List of regions to exclude.
- `exclude_tags_filter` (Map of String) Excluded tags filter.
- `instance_connect` (Boolean) Enable instance connect.
- `instance_ids_filter` (List of String) List of instance IDs filter.
- `regions_filter` (List of String) List of regions filter.
- `ssm` (Boolean) Enable SSM.
- `tags_filter` (Map of String) Tags filter.

<a id="nestedatt--scan_configuration--ec2_scan_options--ebs_scan_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scan_configuration.ec2_scan_options.ebs_scan_options`

Optional:

- `max_asg_instances` (Number, Deprecated) Max ASG instances.
- `target_instances_per_scanner` (Number, Deprecated) Target instances per scanner.



<a id="nestedatt--scan_configuration--cross_account_scan_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scan_configuration.cross_account_scan_options`

Optional:

- `account_ids` (List of String) The AWS account IDs to scan.
- `account_tags` (Map of String) Tag key to tag value. Only accounts that carry at least one of these tags are scanned; when empty, every account is scanned. A value of `*` matches any value of the key.
- `ebs_volume_scan` (Boolean) Scan the target accounts' EC2 instances through snapshots of their EBS volumes. Takes effect only while `cross_account_scan` and `ec2_scan_options.ebs_volume_scan` are on, and only in target accounts whose Mondoo role was deployed with the `EbsScanning` opt-in.
- `organizations` (Map of String) Foreign AWS Organizations to scan in addition to the Lambda's own organization: AWS Organization ID (e.g. `o-abc123defg`) to the 12-digit ID of its management (or delegated administrator) account. The Lambda assumes `role_name` in that account to list the organization's accounts, and scans every active account in it.
- `role_name` (String) The IAM role the Lambda assumes in each target account. Set it when you create the integration. Once the deployed CloudFormation stack checks in, Mondoo keeps the role name the stack reports (its `CrossAccountScanRoleName` parameter), so a later change here is not applied: change it in the stack.


<a id="nestedatt--scan_configuration--event_scan_triggers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scan_configuration.event_scan_triggers`

Optional:

- `event_detail_type` (String) Event detail type.
- `event_source` (String) Event source.
- `scan_type` (String) Scan type.


<a id="nestedatt--scan_configuration--vpc_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scan_configuration.vpc_configuration`

Optional:

- `cidr_block` (String) CIDR block for the Mondoo VPC.
- `use_mondoo_vpc` (Boolean, Deprecated) Use Mondoo VPC.
- `vpc_flavour` (String) VPC flavour, one of: DEFAULT_VPC, MONDOO_NATGW, MONDOO_IGW, CUSTOM_VPC.
- `vpc_tag` (Attributes) VPC tag to use when vpc_flavour is set to CUSTOM_VPC. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scan_configuration--vpc_configuration--vpc_tag))

<a id="nestedatt--scan_configuration--vpc_configuration--vpc_tag"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scan_configuration.vpc_configuration.vpc_tag`

Required:

- `key` (String) Key of the VPC tag.
- `value` (String) Value of the VPC tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import using integration MRN.
terraform import mondoo_integration_aws_serverless.aws_serverless "//captain.api.mondoo.app/spaces/hungry-poet-123456/integrations/2Abd08lk860"
```
